task.title: Encode planning execution graph metadata
task.summary: Add canonical planning trace fields for work units, dependencies, waves, leases, route-backs, gates, and publisher serialization.

goal.outcome: Planning trace can carry execution graph metadata that agency/runtime/graph surfaces use for safe parallel implementation handoff without spawning workers automatically.
acceptance: Planning build schema or trace data supports work units, dependencies, waves, conflict scopes, lease plan, roles, required gates, route-back triggers, and publisher serialization.
Agency planning reads or reports execution graph metadata as authorization context while preserving configured budgets and stop gates.
Runtime/status surfaces can project dispatch intent without bypassing leases, worktrees, fresh validation, or publisher serialization.
Graph/read-model projection exposes execution graph metadata as derived view only.
TASK-specific tests cover execution graph parsing/projection and route-back/serialization metadata.
non_goals: Do not spawn background workers automatically.
Do not bypass artifact leases, validation gates, or publisher serialization.
Do not create a second canonical graph outside planning trace data.
verification: targeted TASK-114 test for planning execution graph metadata
targeted graph/lens or runtime handoff projection test

delta.desired: Planning trace carries canonical execution graph metadata and runtime/graph project it for scheduling context.
delta.current: Planning output lacks consistent execution graph metadata for safe parallel implementation handoff.
delta.closure: Closed when planning builds can encode and expose worker waves, dependencies, and leases without executing workers.
